newsitem.title: FRANCE: France calls for restraint over Serbia poll.
newsitem.headline: France calls for restraint over Serbia poll.

text.p: France on Friday called for restraint from all sides in a dispute over local elections in Serbia and recalled the European Union made respect for democracy a condition for normalising relations with Belgrade.

Foreign Ministry spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt said Paris was concerned by the stalemate between President Slobodan Milosevic's Socialists, trying to annul local election results they lost, and opposition attempts to secure their victory.

"It is essential that a democratic solution be found," Rummelhardt told reporters at a news briefing. "Respect of democratic norms is among the first conditions set by the European Union to normalise relations with (rump) Yugoslavia.
Students and opposition leaders were demonstrating on Friday in a fifth day of protests in Belgrade and towns across Serbia to demand the results of last Sunday's polls be recognised.
